description: This PHP class defines a Data Access Object (DAO) for handling RegistrationEventQueue entities within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to save registration events, retrieve events by type, and fetch unpublished events with a limit.

classes.name: RegistrationEventQueueDao
classes.description: DAO class for RegistrationEventQueue entities, providing methods for CRUD operations and queries based on registration event data.

methods.name: saveRegistrationEvent
methods.description: Persists a RegistrationEventQueue entity to the database and returns the saved entity.

methods.name: getRegistrationEventByType
methods.description: Retrieves a RegistrationEventQueue entity based on the specified event type, ordered by descending ID.

methods.name: getUnpublishedRegistrationEvents
methods.description: Fetches a limited number of unpublished registration event entities.
